description: Create a real estate flyer for an Open House using LibreOffice Writer. Open /home/ga/Documents/property_draft.docx which contains raw text. (1) Format the first line 'OPEN HOUSE - SUNDAY' as a centered, bold, large title (>=24pt). (2) Insert the image /home/ga/Documents/images/luxury_home.jpg below the address, resizing it to fill the page width (approx 6-7 inches). (3) Format the remaining text (Description and Features) into two columns using a Section (Insert > Section). (4) Convert the list of features into a bulleted list. Save the result as an ODT file at /home/ga/Documents/open_house_flyer.odt.
